name: ranavista
description: Ranavista — B2B RFQ marketplace (MERN): website, admin panel and API

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c green,yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix admin run build
